description: A cozy, if somewhat dusty, bedroom tucked away in the attic. A small window allows a sliver of moonlight to fall across the floor.

wall.description: A wallpapered wall with a pattern of tiny buttons.

exit_north.description: A small hole leads up to the attic corner.

stairs_down.description: The stairs lead back down to the main floor of Fred's house.

cobweb_closet.onInteract: You peer into the small closet. It's filled with tangled cobwebs and old, faded shoelaces from forgotten shoes.
cobweb_closet.description: A miniature wooden closet door, covered in spiderwebs.

item.name: Wild Potato
item.opened_description: A peeled-back corner of the carpet. Just bare floorboards remain.
item.onCollect: You pull back the corner of the loose carpet and find a perfectly preserved Wild Potato hidden underneath!

loose_carpet.description: A corner of the soft carpet that seems to have peeled back.

item_pillow.onInteract: You poke the cotton-ball pillow. It's incredibly soft and springy—perfect for a tired sole.
item_pillow.description: A tiny pillow made of a single cotton ball.

item_photo.onInteract: You turn the dusty photo face up. It shows two young baby slippers, Fred and Derf, playing happily in Shoeboxlandia before Derf's exile behind the mountains. You shed a single, starchy tear.
item_photo.description: An old, dusty photo lying face down on the floor.

item_magnifying_lens.onInteract: You peer through the magnifying lens. The dust motes floating in the moonlight look like massive, glowing stardust particles.
item_magnifying_lens.description: A highly polished magnifying lens is catching the sliver of moonlight.
